ipos.prose:
As of today, the EverestIMS Technologies IPO grey market premium is ₹26.5 at the median of 4 trackers, with quotes spread between ₹10 and ₹28. The median has climbed ₹4.5 since yesterday, a sign of strengthening unofficial demand. Note the disagreement: trackers are 67.9% apart, which usually points to a thin grey market where any single number deserves skepticism.

Set against the upper price band of ₹85, today's median implies an estimated listing gain of about 31.18% — a sentiment reading, not a forecast. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 1.7× overall — modest so far. The issue is open for bidding now (29 Sep – 5 Oct) — see the full IPO calendar for what opens next. Our confidence grade on today's number is medium (58/100); the full breakdown is below.

Being an SME listing, the usual caveat is louder: SME grey markets are shallow, tracker spreads run widest in our data, and a thin market is an easy one to move. On the timeline, the EverestIMS Technologies IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 6 Oct, with listing expected 8 Oct. For the EverestIMS Technologies IPO, one lot is 1600 shares and the issue size is ₹48.46 Cr. See also EverestIMS Technologies IPO subscription status and EverestIMS Technologies IPO allotment status. This EverestIMS Technologies IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
As of today, the Vishal Nirmiti IPO grey market premium is ₹21 at the median of 4 trackers, with quotes spread between ₹20 and ₹25. The median is unchanged from yesterday. Trackers differ by about 23.8% right now — moderate disagreement, so read the range rather than the median alone.

Set against the upper price band of ₹220, today's median implies an estimated listing gain of about 9.55% — a sentiment reading, not a forecast. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 0.6× overall — modest so far. The issue is open for bidding now (30 Sep – 5 Oct) — see the full IPO calendar for what opens next. Our confidence grade on today's number is medium (50/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. On the timeline, the Vishal Nirmiti IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 6 Oct, with listing expected 8 Oct. For the Vishal Nirmiti IPO, one lot is 68 shares and the issue size is ₹178.00 Cr. See also Vishal Nirmiti IPO subscription status and Vishal Nirmiti IPO allotment status. This Vishal Nirmiti IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
Right now the grey market is pricing the TNA Solutions IPO at a median premium of ₹6 — the midpoint of 4 trackers, whose quotes range from ₹5 to ₹7. That is ₹0.5 below yesterday's median — the premium has cooled a step. Trackers differ by about 33.3% right now — moderate disagreement, so read the range rather than the median alone.

Set against the upper price band of ₹70, today's median implies an estimated listing gain of about 8.57% — a sentiment reading, not a forecast. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 1.71× overall — modest so far. The issue is open for bidding now (30 Sep – 6 Oct) — see the full IPO calendar for what opens next. Our confidence grade on today's number is medium (57/100); the full breakdown is below.

Being an SME listing, the usual caveat is louder: SME grey markets are shallow, tracker spreads run widest in our data, and a thin market is an easy one to move. On the timeline, the TNA Solutions IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 7 Oct, with listing expected 9 Oct. For the TNA Solutions IPO, one lot is 2000 shares and the issue size is ₹37.86 Cr. See also TNA Solutions IPO subscription status and TNA Solutions IPO allotment status. This TNA Solutions IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
As of today, the Acme Universal Safezone 9 IPO grey market premium is ₹11 at the median of 5 trackers, with quotes spread between ₹0 and ₹14. The median is unchanged from yesterday. Note the disagreement: trackers are 127.3% apart, which usually points to a thin grey market where any single number deserves skepticism.

Set against the upper price band of ₹196, today's median implies an estimated listing gain of about 5.61% — a sentiment reading, not a forecast. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 16.41× overall — strong. The issue is open for bidding now (30 Sep – 6 Oct) — see the full IPO calendar for what opens next. Our confidence grade on today's number is medium (51/100); the full breakdown is below.

Being an SME listing, the usual caveat is louder: SME grey markets are shallow, tracker spreads run widest in our data, and a thin market is an easy one to move. On the timeline, the Acme Universal Safezone 9 IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 7 Oct, with listing expected 9 Oct. For the Acme Universal Safezone 9 IPO, one lot is 600 shares and the issue size is ₹121.69 Cr. See also Acme Universal Safezone 9 IPO subscription status and Acme Universal Safezone 9 IPO allotment status. This Acme Universal Safezone 9 IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

माँग की तरफ़ देखें तो यह इश्यू कुल 1.35 गुना सब्सक्राइब हो चुका है। बोली अभी खुली है (30 Sep – 6 Oct)। Paramount Syntex आईपीओ की अलॉटमेंट तारीख़ 7 Oct है, और लिस्टिंग 9 Oct को अपेक्षित है। यह एक एसएमई इश्यू है, इसलिए सावधानी ज़्यादा ज़रूरी है: एसएमई का ग्रे मार्केट पतला होता है, हमारे आँकड़ों में ट्रैकरों का मतभेद यहीं सबसे ज़्यादा रहता है, और छोटे बाज़ार को प्रभावित करना आसान होता है।

faq_hi.a: Paramount Syntex आईपीओ का बेसिस ऑफ़ अलॉटमेंट 7 Oct को तय होना है, और लिस्टिंग 9 Oct को अपेक्षित है। अलॉटमेंट की स्थिति रजिस्ट्रार और एक्सचेंज उसी दिन प्रकाशित करते हैं।

subscription_faq.q: How many times is the Paramount Syntex IPO subscribed?
subscription_faq.a: The Paramount Syntex IPO is subscribed 1.35 times overall so far. In the retail category an oversubscribed issue is allotted by computerised lottery, so every valid one-lot application has the same chance.

subscription_faq.q: When does the Paramount Syntex IPO close?
subscription_faq.a: The Paramount Syntex IPO bidding window is 30 Sep – 6 Oct. Subscription figures are published by the exchanges through the day and are final only after the book closes.

subscription_faq.q: What is the Paramount Syntex IPO lot size?
subscription_faq.a: One lot of the Paramount Syntex IPO is 1000 shares, at a price band of Rs 127.0.

subscription_faq.q: Does high subscription mean I will get Paramount Syntex IPO allotment?
subscription_faq.a: No. A heavily subscribed issue means the opposite: allotment in the retail category is decided by lottery, so the more applications there are, the lower each one's chance. Subscription measures demand, not your odds.

allotment_faq.q: When is the Paramount Syntex IPO allotment date?
allotment_faq.a: The basis of allotment for the Paramount Syntex IPO is expected on 7 Oct, with listing expected on 9 Oct. The registrar and the exchanges publish status on that date; no third-party site can show it earlier.

allotment_faq.q: How do I check Paramount Syntex IPO allotment status?
allotment_faq.a: Check on the registrar's official allotment page, on the BSE application-status page, or with your broker — by PAN, application number or DP/client ID. All three are free. If you applied by UPI, the mandate being debited is often the earliest signal.

allotment_faq.q: Was the Paramount Syntex IPO oversubscribed?
allotment_faq.a: The Paramount Syntex IPO is subscribed 1.35 times overall. Retail allotment is therefore by lottery.

faq.q: What are the dates for Eventions Limited IPO?
faq.a: Eventions Limited IPO dates: 30 Sep – 5 Oct — currently open. Under the T+3 listing timeline, allotment is typically finalised about one working day after the issue closes, with listing around three working days after close. Confirm exact dates in the RHP and on the registrar's site.

faq.q: What is the lot size and minimum investment for Eventions Limited IPO?
faq.a: One lot of Eventions Limited IPO is 1200 shares. At the upper end of the price band (₹118), the minimum retail application is ₹2,83,200 for 2 lots. Retail applications are made in whole lots only.

faq.q: What is the issue size of Eventions Limited IPO?
faq.a: The Eventions Limited IPO issue size is ₹38.12 Cr, and it is a SME issue. Issue size is the total amount the company is raising, and it is one of the factors that decides how much stock reaches retail applicants.

faq.q: Who is the registrar for Eventions Limited IPO?
faq.a: The registrar for Eventions Limited IPO is Mudra RTA Ventures Private Limited. The registrar processes applications and finalises the basis of allotment, and its website is where allotment status is checked once results are published.

faq.q: What are Eventions Limited's revenue and profit?
faq.a: Revenue from operations: FY26 ₹99.74 crore, FY25 ₹87.53 crore, FY24 ₹86.57 crore. Revenue grew 13.9% year-on-year in FY26. Profit after tax was ₹7.72 crore in FY26, ₹5.13 crore in FY25, ₹3.29 crore in FY24. These are restated figures from the company's own Red Herring Prospectus, page 59 — the SEBI-mandated disclosure filed with the exchange.

ipos.prose:
The Eventions Limited IPO grey market premium is still at zero across the 3 trackers we track — typical before dealers begin quoting, especially ahead of the price band or dates. We poll every tracker hourly, so the first quoted premium appears here as soon as it is published — dealers usually begin quoting around the price-band announcement, and almost always by the time bidding opens.

On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 1.79× overall — modest so far. The issue is open for bidding now (30 Sep – 5 Oct) — see the full IPO calendar for what opens next. No confidence grade is published while no tracker is quoting a premium — there would be nothing for it to measure.

A structural caution applies: this is an SME issue, and SME grey markets are thin — our own data shows tracker disagreement is consistently widest here, and small markets are the easiest to paint. On the timeline, the Eventions Limited IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 6 Oct, with listing expected 8 Oct. For the Eventions Limited IPO, one lot is 1200 shares and the issue size is ₹38.12 Cr. See also Eventions Limited IPO subscription status and Eventions Limited IPO allotment status. This Eventions Limited IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
The SJP Ultrasonic IPO grey market premium is still at zero across the 3 trackers we track — typical before dealers begin quoting, especially ahead of the price band or dates. We poll every tracker hourly, so the first quoted premium appears here as soon as it is published — dealers usually begin quoting around the price-band announcement, and almost always by the time bidding opens.

On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 0.54× overall — modest so far. The issue is open for bidding now (30 Sep – 5 Oct) — see the full IPO calendar for what opens next. No confidence grade is published while no tracker is quoting a premium — there would be nothing for it to measure.

A structural caution applies: this is an SME issue, and SME grey markets are thin — our own data shows tracker disagreement is consistently widest here, and small markets are the easiest to paint. On the timeline, the SJP Ultrasonic IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 6 Oct, with listing expected 8 Oct. For the SJP Ultrasonic IPO, one lot is 2000 shares and the issue size is ₹23.45 Cr. See also SJP Ultrasonic IPO subscription status and SJP Ultrasonic IPO allotment status. This SJP Ultrasonic IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
The Vans Electroengineerings IPO grey market premium (GMP) stands at a median of ₹70 today, drawn from 5 trackers we monitor — with individual quotes running from ₹60 to ₹90. The median is unchanged from yesterday. Note the disagreement: trackers are 42.9% apart, which usually points to a thin grey market where any single number deserves skepticism.

Measured off the ₹118 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 59.32%; treat it as expectation, not promise. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 628.73× overall — strong. Bidding has closed; the premium now tracks expectations into allotment and listing. Our confidence grade on today's number is medium (68/100); the full breakdown is below.

Being an SME listing, the usual caveat is louder: SME grey markets are shallow, tracker spreads run widest in our data, and a thin market is an easy one to move. On the timeline, the Vans Electroengineerings IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 2 Oct, with listing expected 7 Oct. For the Vans Electroengineerings IPO, one lot is 1200 shares and the issue size is ₹33.98 Cr. See also Vans Electroengineerings IPO subscription status and Vans Electroengineerings IPO allotment status. This Vans Electroengineerings IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
As of today, the Orient Cables (India) IPO grey market premium is ₹107 at the median of 5 trackers, with quotes spread between ₹100 and ₹116. That is ₹6.5 above yesterday's median — grey-market demand is firming. Quotes cluster tightly across trackers, the mark of a comparatively liquid grey market.

Measured off the ₹272 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 39.34%; treat it as expectation, not promise. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 97.28× overall — strong. Bidding has closed; the premium now tracks expectations into allotment and listing. Our confidence grade on today's number is high (85/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. The Orient Cables (India) IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 30 Sep; the listing date has not been published yet. For the Orient Cables (India) IPO, one lot is 55 shares and the issue size is ₹552.00 Cr. See also Orient Cables (India) IPO subscription status and Orient Cables (India) IPO allotment status. This Orient Cables (India) IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
As of today, the SRIT India IPO grey market premium is ₹48 at the median of 5 trackers, with quotes spread between ₹44 and ₹50. That is ₹0.5 below yesterday's median — the premium has cooled a step. Quotes cluster tightly across trackers, the mark of a comparatively liquid grey market.

Measured off the ₹130 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 36.92%; treat it as expectation, not promise. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 125.16× overall — strong. Bidding has closed; the premium now tracks expectations into allotment and listing. Our confidence grade on today's number is high (81/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. The SRIT India IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 1 Oct; the listing date has not been published yet. For the SRIT India IPO, one lot is 115 shares and the issue size is ₹218.40 Cr. See also SRIT India IPO subscription status and SRIT India IPO allotment status. This SRIT India IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

subscription_faq.q: How many times is the SRIT India IPO subscribed?
subscription_faq.a: The SRIT India IPO is subscribed 125.16 times overall so far. In the retail category an oversubscribed issue is allotted by computerised lottery, so every valid one-lot application has the same chance.

subscription_faq.a: The SRIT India IPO bidding window is 28–30 Sep. Subscription figures are published by the exchanges through the day and are final only after the book closes.

subscription_faq.q: What is the SRIT India IPO lot size?
subscription_faq.a: One lot of the SRIT India IPO is 115 shares, at a price band of Rs 130.0.

subscription_faq.q: Does high subscription mean I will get SRIT India IPO allotment?
subscription_faq.a: No. A heavily subscribed issue means the opposite: allotment in the retail category is decided by lottery, so the more applications there are, the lower each one's chance. Subscription measures demand, not your odds.

allotment_faq.q: When is the SRIT India IPO allotment date?

allotment_faq.q: How do I check SRIT India IPO allotment status?
allotment_faq.a: Check on the registrar's official allotment page, on the BSE application-status page, or with your broker — by PAN, application number or DP/client ID. All three are free. If you applied by UPI, the mandate being debited is often the earliest signal.

allotment_faq.q: Was the SRIT India IPO oversubscribed?
allotment_faq.a: The SRIT India IPO is subscribed 125.16 times overall. Retail allotment is therefore by lottery.

ipos.prose:
The Black Opal Consultants IPO grey market premium (GMP) stands at a median of ₹60 today, drawn from 5 trackers we monitor — with individual quotes running from ₹30 to ₹68. The median has climbed ₹8 since yesterday, a sign of strengthening unofficial demand. Note the disagreement: trackers are 63.3% apart, which usually points to a thin grey market where any single number deserves skepticism.

Measured off the ₹197 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 30.46%; treat it as expectation, not promise. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 73.8× overall — strong. Bidding has closed; the premium now tracks expectations into allotment and listing. Our confidence grade on today's number is medium (67/100); the full breakdown is below.

A structural caution applies: this is an SME issue, and SME grey markets are thin — our own data shows tracker disagreement is consistently widest here, and small markets are the easiest to paint. On the timeline, the Black Opal Consultants IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 2 Oct, with listing expected 7 Oct. For the Black Opal Consultants IPO, one lot is 600 shares and the issue size is ₹55.08 Cr. See also Black Opal Consultants IPO subscription status and Black Opal Consultants IPO allotment status. This Black Opal Consultants IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
Right now the grey market is pricing the Bench Mark Infotech Services IPO at a median premium of ₹25 — the midpoint of 5 trackers, whose quotes range from ₹22 to ₹29. The median is unchanged from yesterday. Trackers differ by about 28% right now — moderate disagreement, so read the range rather than the median alone.

Set against the upper price band of ₹110, today's median implies an estimated listing gain of about 22.73% — a sentiment reading, not a forecast. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 103.12× overall — strong. Bidding has closed; the premium now tracks expectations into allotment and listing. Our confidence grade on today's number is high (72/100); the full breakdown is below.

A structural caution applies: this is an SME issue, and SME grey markets are thin — our own data shows tracker disagreement is consistently widest here, and small markets are the easiest to paint. The Bench Mark Infotech Services IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 30 Sep; the listing date has not been published yet. For the Bench Mark Infotech Services IPO, one lot is 1200 shares and the issue size is ₹42.44 Cr. See also Bench Mark Infotech Services IPO subscription status and Bench Mark Infotech Services IPO allotment status. This Bench Mark Infotech Services IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

₹110 के ऊपरी प्राइस बैंड के मुक़ाबले यह प्रीमियम लगभग 22.73% के अनुमानित लिस्टिंग लाभ की ओर इशारा करता है — यह बाज़ार की उम्मीद है, कोई भविष्यवाणी नहीं। माँग की तरफ़ देखें तो यह इश्यू कुल 103.12 गुना सब्सक्राइब हो चुका है। बोली बंद हो चुकी है; अब प्रीमियम अलॉटमेंट और लिस्टिंग की उम्मीदों पर चल रहा है। Bench Mark Infotech Services आईपीओ की अलॉटमेंट तारीख़ 30 Sep है। यह एक एसएमई इश्यू है, इसलिए सावधानी ज़्यादा ज़रूरी है: एसएमई का ग्रे मार्केट पतला होता है, हमारे आँकड़ों में ट्रैकरों का मतभेद यहीं सबसे ज़्यादा रहता है, और छोटे बाज़ार को प्रभावित करना आसान होता है।

subscription_faq.q: How many times is the Bench Mark Infotech Services IPO subscribed?
subscription_faq.a: The Bench Mark Infotech Services IPO is subscribed 103.12 times overall so far. In the retail category an oversubscribed issue is allotted by computerised lottery, so every valid one-lot application has the same chance.

subscription_faq.q: When does the Bench Mark Infotech Services IPO close?
subscription_faq.a: The Bench Mark Infotech Services IPO bidding window is 25–29 Sep. Subscription figures are published by the exchanges through the day and are final only after the book closes.

subscription_faq.q: What is the Bench Mark Infotech Services IPO lot size?
subscription_faq.a: One lot of the Bench Mark Infotech Services IPO is 1200.0 shares, at a price band of Rs 110.0.

subscription_faq.q: Does high subscription mean I will get Bench Mark Infotech Services IPO allotment?
subscription_faq.a: No. A heavily subscribed issue means the opposite: allotment in the retail category is decided by lottery, so the more applications there are, the lower each one's chance. Subscription measures demand, not your odds.

allotment_faq.q: When is the Bench Mark Infotech Services IPO allotment date?
allotment_faq.a: The basis of allotment for the Bench Mark Infotech Services IPO is expected on 30 Sep. The registrar and the exchanges publish status on that date; no third-party site can show it earlier.

allotment_faq.q: How do I check Bench Mark Infotech Services IPO allotment status?
allotment_faq.a: Check on the registrar's official allotment page, on the BSE application-status page, or with your broker — by PAN, application number or DP/client ID. All three are free. If you applied by UPI, the mandate being debited is often the earliest signal.

allotment_faq.q: Was the Bench Mark Infotech Services IPO oversubscribed?
allotment_faq.a: The Bench Mark Infotech Services IPO is subscribed 103.12 times overall. Retail allotment is therefore by lottery.

ipos.prose:
Right now the grey market is pricing the German Green Steel Power IPO at a median premium of ₹13 — the midpoint of 5 trackers, whose quotes range from ₹12 to ₹14. That is ₹0.5 above yesterday's median — grey-market demand is firming. Trackers differ by about 15.4% right now — moderate disagreement, so read the range rather than the median alone.

Measured off the ₹139 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 9.35%; treat it as expectation, not promise. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 30.42× overall — strong. Bidding has closed; the premium now tracks expectations into allotment and listing. Our confidence grade on today's number is high (83/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. The German Green Steel Power IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 30 Sep; the listing date has not been published yet. For the German Green Steel Power IPO, one lot is 107 shares and the issue size is ₹303.90 Cr. See also German Green Steel Power IPO subscription status and German Green Steel Power IPO allotment status. This German Green Steel Power IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
Right now the grey market is pricing the Shah Investor's Home IPO at a median premium of ₹12 — the midpoint of 5 trackers, whose quotes range from ₹11 to ₹15. That is ₹0.5 below yesterday's median — the premium has cooled a step. Trackers differ by about 33.3% right now — moderate disagreement, so read the range rather than the median alone.

Measured off the ₹167 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 7.19%; treat it as expectation, not promise. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 38.12× overall — strong. Bidding has closed; the premium now tracks expectations into allotment and listing. Our confidence grade on today's number is high (73/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. The Shah Investor's Home IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 1 Oct; the listing date has not been published yet. For the Shah Investor's Home IPO, one lot is 85 shares and the issue size is ₹90.17 Cr. See also Shah Investor's Home IPO subscription status and Shah Investor's Home IPO allotment status. This Shah Investor's Home IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

Note the disagreement: trackers are 100% apart, which usually points to a thin grey market where any single number deserves skepticism.

Measured off the ₹62 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 1.61%; treat it as expectation, not promise. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 2.2× overall — healthy. Bidding has closed; the premium now tracks expectations into allotment and listing. Our confidence grade on today's number is medium (48/100); the full breakdown is below.

Being an SME listing, the usual caveat is louder: SME grey markets are shallow, tracker spreads run widest in our data, and a thin market is an easy one to move. For the Shivchem Agro IPO, one lot is 2000 shares and the issue size is ₹14.01 Cr. See also Shivchem Agro IPO subscription status. ipos.prose:
Right now the grey market is pricing the Pind Hospitality IPO at a median premium of ₹1 — the midpoint of 3 trackers, whose quotes range from ₹1 to ₹1. The median is unchanged from yesterday. Quotes cluster tightly across trackers, the mark of a comparatively liquid grey market.

Set against the upper price band of ₹99, today's median implies an estimated listing gain of about 1.01% — a sentiment reading, not a forecast. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 2.71× overall — healthy. Bidding has closed; the premium now tracks expectations into allotment and listing. Our confidence grade on today's number is medium (69/100); the full breakdown is below.

A structural caution applies: this is an SME issue, and SME grey markets are thin — our own data shows tracker disagreement is consistently widest here, and small markets are the easiest to paint. For the Pind Hospitality IPO, one lot is 1200 shares and the issue size is ₹17.82 Cr. See also Pind Hospitality IPO subscription status. This Pind Hospitality IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
The Runwal Enterprises IPO grey market premium (GMP) stands at a median of ₹2 today, drawn from 5 trackers we monitor — with individual quotes running from ₹-5 to ₹7. That is ₹2 above yesterday's median — grey-market demand is firming. Note the disagreement: trackers are 600% apart, which usually points to a thin grey market where any single number deserves skepticism.

Measured off the ₹305 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 0.66%; treat it as expectation, not promise. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 2.63× overall — healthy. Bidding has closed; the premium now tracks expectations into allotment and listing. Our confidence grade on today's number is low (41/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. The Runwal Enterprises IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 30 Sep; the listing date has not been published yet. For the Runwal Enterprises IPO, one lot is 49 shares and the issue size is ₹500.00 Cr. See also Runwal Enterprises IPO subscription status and Runwal Enterprises IPO allotment status. This Runwal Enterprises IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.
